notes.title: Version [v1.0.4190] Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Our latest build of Audio Trip is patched, public, and ready for all you Trippers!

This patch addresses several known issues from the latest update, and some improvements, thanks to all of your feedback!
[hr][/hr]
[h2]>> Patch Notes >>[/h2]

[i]We've fixed and upgraded...[/i]

[i][h3]Achievements[/h3][/i]
[olist]
[*]Fixed bug where achievements for star counts were not being unlocked.
[*]Fixed issue where some achievements might not get synchronized due to excessively large queues.
[*]Improved synchronization of earned achievements with native platforms.
[/olist]
[i][h3]Custom Editor[/h3][/i]
[olist]
[*]Fixed all known choreography editor issues.
[*]Fixed stuck-at-black-screen issues caused by custom songs that had errors in them.
[*]Increased tolerance for custom song files that have errors in them.
[*]Fixed issue where all choreographies of a song would get duplicated when trying to create your own empty choreography from either a built-in song or someone else's custom song.
[/olist]
[i][h3]Campaign Mode[/h3][/i]
[olist]
[*]Fixed incorrect accuracy numbers.
[*]Fixed issues with one-hand modifier.
[*]Changed display for max beat streak challenge to display the current streak rather than the max streak so far.
[/olist]
[i][h3]General Gameplay[/h3][/i]
[olist]
[*]Menus should no longer be inside the floor if your headset is placed on the ground.
[*]Fixed issue where restarting a custom version of a built-in song would freeze the game.
[*]Improved song timing that was thrown off by latency changes due to recent audio subsystem updates.
[*]Fixed hand particles setting not saving.
[/olist]
[i]And... that's about it![/i]

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35688153/c48686af2c4e8a92619fcb290d5c18f557ebc43f.png[/img]
[i][b]NOTE:[/b] Select the correct channel![/i]
Make sure you are on the public "default" channel and all betas are set to "[none]." We've linked these notes to the latest build so you can find it that way, too.
[hr][/hr]

As we continue to tweak, improve, and develop Audio Trip, the input of our playerbase will continue to be invaluable! If you're experiencing issues that are not listed here, don't worry! Leave a comment on this announcement or on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/9mvhfyxf7Z]Discord![/url]

[i]Keep Trippin',[/i]
ːp2cubeː Audio Trip Team

notes.title: Audio Trip Fanatics Features Update
notes.notes:
[i]You asked for it, and we delivered![/i]

[i][h2][u]NEW FEATURES in Version 1.0.3192::[/u][/h2][/i]
[list][*] [b]TRIP INFO:[/b] Display the current song, artist, choreography, and choreographer (if custom) during your Trip. -- This info defaults to fade away during gameplay, but there's another option to have it [i]Always On[/i]

[*] [b]FAVORITES:[/b] Is this Trip one of your favorites? Now when you're playing, just pause your trip and click the '☆ Favorites' button in the pause menu, and a new " ★ Favorites" Playlist will appear in the Hub World. And of course you can edit and add to this new playlist, as long as you have Playlists mode enabled.

[*] [b]PLAYLIST STATS:[/b] - Also in Playlists mode, you can click the playlist stats button on the pause menu to see all your info on the Trips you've already played, and which ones you have left in the playlist.

[*] [b]MANUAL HEIGHT SETTING:[/b] We've always automatically set your height for each trip, but now you can calibrate and lock your height. Check it out under 'Options'.

[*] [b]AUDIBLE METRONOME:[/b] Optional metronome that clicks to the BPM (in addition to the visual brightness pulse) when setting up a song - See it under the Custom menu, 'Edit Song' page.

[*] [b]DRUM SFX:[/b] - Under the same page as above, you can also now choose which drum SFX to use!

[*] [b]BARRIER COLORS:[/b] New 'Custom Visuals' option under Options menu has all the colors for the gameplay elements, [i]including barriers![/i]

[*] [b]HAND PARTICLES SETTINGS:[/b] Under the same page as above, you can now set the amount of hand particles to show during gameplay.
[/list]

[i]Have fun![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35688153/2454cb58af74b2d75b40cf90698ca4f08edf320d.png[/img] Kinemotik

notes.title: Audio Trip Launch Anniversary (Update + NEW FEATURE)
notes.notes:
[i]First things first... To celebrate our Steam Launch Anniversary, we're introducing [b]a different way to enjoy the game[/b] with: [/i]

[i][h2]NEW: Scenery Only Mode[/h2][/i]
This will allow you to fly through any environment to just enjoy the scenery, with the gameplay (choreography) disabled.
Some of you have asked for this for a while, and we're honoured you love our environments so much that you just want to watch them! We've certainly put a ton of work into them so far. So if you want to just chill out to the trippy scenes, you can find this new mode under the 'Options' menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35688153/f6fcf100ee8d82c1194830bbe87de76a152fe0ef.png[/img]


[i] Secondly... We have even [b]more updates and less bugs![/b][/i]

[i][h2]More NEW STUFF:[/h2][/i] [list]
[*] NEW: [b]WebSockets server[/b] to stream game stats to other client apps.  
-- [i]Useful for streaming overlays, etc, for all of our lovely streamers![/i]
[*] NEW: Ability to set [b]custom beat divisions[/b] in your choreography (.ats) file.[/list]

[i][h2]And some Improvements: [/h2][/i][list]
[*] Player height now only measured once at the start of a playlist.
[*] Improved game resume count-down text visibility[/list]

[i][h2]And Fixes: [/h2][/i][list]
[*] Squashed some sneaky lighting, shader, and material bugs in the environments.
[*] Fixed a bug where opening the SteamVR dashboard while exiting a song could lead to an unresponsive UI.
[*] No more temporary disappearing of all custom choreography items when deleting one of them.
[*] Fixed Vive controller buttons not working.[/list]


[i]Thank you [b]so much[/b] to our players who report these issues to us! It helps us hunt them down and fix them for everyone. Please continue letting us know if you think something doesn't seem right![/i]

Have fun celebrating with us!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35688153/2454cb58af74b2d75b40cf90698ca4f08edf320d.png[/img] Kinemotik

notes.title: Update: Fresh Features for the Choreography Editor & Contest Reminder!
notes.notes:
[h2]More tools to create custom songs![/h2]

Just a quick note about some new features and fixes for the Choreography Editor coming at you hot at the start of this fine week. These enhancements are coming just in time, too, as it's the final week to submit your custom choreography for the [b]Golden Pineapple Choreography Contest![/b] We hope the impact these new options have on your experience creating custom trips is as big and bold as your moves! ːsteamhappyː

-------------------------------
Now onto the good stuff...

[h2]Choreography Editor fixes and features![/h2][list]
[*] [b]NEW.[/b] [i][b]Mirror your moves![/b][/i] Save time by creating mirrored versions of sections to do the same move on the opposite side, along the x-axis. When you've copied a section you'd like, save it as a snippet, then just hit the new mirror button next to the snippets (see circled button in screenshot below) to create a mirrored snippet to use! (see adjacent new mirrored snippet)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35688153/6a5ba50d2dca37cf72a70f9c0b04f4dc18602916.png[/img]

[*] [b]NEW.[/b] [i][b]Drag elements forward and backward in time.[/b][/i] Grab any game element (Gems, DirGems, Ribbons, Drums, Walls) using the trigger, and drag using the grips at the same time to move the element (in real-time!) as you move through the song. 

[*] [b]NEW.[/b] [i][b]Pinch delete ribbons![/b][/i] You can now pinch delete the beginning and end of Ribbons to make them shorter! This is the same pinch delete you can use for any gameplay element, by holding the element (using the trigger) and clicking the joystick or trackpad (depending on your controller) to delete! [i]Note - if you pinch-delete the middle of a ribbon, the entire ribbon will be deleted.[/i]


[*] [b]FIX.[/b] Drum sentience has been dialed back, they should no longer move of their own accord. We fixed a strange bug that was erroneously moving the position of drums for some players. ːsteamsadː Please let us know if this persists for you![/list]

-------------------------------
[h2]DON'T FORGET[/h2]
[h3]There is just a little bit of time left in our Choreography Contest! [/h3]
Use our in-headset level editor for a chance to win a first-place prize of $1000. 
[h2][i][b]All submissions must be received by June 7.[/b][/i] [/h2]
Join our [url=http://audio.chat]Discord[/url] to learn more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35688153/12f7002350a80be63362486e3a25a5da53b81f17.png[/img]

[h3]See you soon and keep dancing![/h3]

<3 Kinemotik

notes.title: Update: First Time Players Help Us Find & Fix Hilarious Bug
notes.notes:
[h2]Our heroes.[/h2]

A bug ONLY affecting first-time players has been fixed today, so thank you to everyone who tried our game and let us know their first trip may have seemed impossibly difficult! You are not bad - It was a bug that was causing players to experience Beginner and Regular choreographies at the same time on their first playthrough! ːsteamfacepalmː The intended mechanic was that players start at Beginner level and--with enough success and a high enough combo--the game would progress to Regular level. What you instead experienced, as mentioned above, were both difficulties simultaneously. No wonder some were having a hard time on their first tries! Thank you so much again for helping us find and splat this bug! ːsteamhappyː

We also took this opportunity to make some other improvements and fixes which you can find below! 

-------------------------------

[h2]<< New in version 1.0.1714 >>[/h2]

[h3]Major Fixes:[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed issue where players might encounter double gems, ribbons, etc on first play-through.
[*] Fixed issue where sometimes the 'You' leaderboard view was not showing where you were on the leaderboard. Now you can see exactly where you stand!
[/list]

[h3]Minor Fixes:[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue with the song timer display on the spectator camera. Now it correctly counts down after restarting a song.
[*] Fixed Undo / Redo in Choreographer Tool conflicting with pausing.
[/list]

[h3]Major Updates:[/h3]
We have enhanced the Choreography Tool with some added features and quality of life improvements!
[list][*] You can now use the grips on the controllers to push and pull backwards and forwards through your custom song in a measured, controlled, and intuitive way!
[*] Drums and Dirgems have a more natural starting position when placing them in your custom choreography. Of course you can then pull the handle on these to rotate them to your liking.
[*] Ribbon Explosion! We created a cool trick for those sweeping gem sections... If you create a ribbon on whatever beat division you choose, you can then choose the gem tool and click on the beginning of the ribbon, and voila! The ribbon will turn into gems along the same curve in that beat division!
[*] Pinch to delete! Try this for a quick erase of an object: While playback is paused, "grab" the item you want to delete ([i]hold down the trigger while hovering over the item with your cursor[/i]) and then while holding the trigger, click the center of the pad or joystick ([i]depending on your controller[/i]). Ta-dah! No need to open the console and switch to erase mode.
[/list]

[h3]Choreography Fix:[/h3]
[list][*] Removed impossible rogue ribbon on beat 78 in Satisfaction Expert. Thank you for finding this, Expert Trippers!
[/list]

[i]...and that's all the fixes for now! Enjoy![/i]
[h3]<3 Kinemotik[/h3]

notes.title: Major Update: New Song, New Moves, New Environment, New Features
notes.notes:
[h1]NEW SONG![/h1]
First things first: yes, we've [i]got a new song for you![/i] We have been hard at work polishing up the choreography and creating the environments for this trip and are absolutely stoked to let you guys dance to it. We hope you love it as much as we do and can't wait to hear what you think!

[h1]BETA GOES LIVE![/h1]
Next, we would like to take a moment to give a huge thank you and shout-out to everyone who has been playing on the beta branch and providing feedback. Your assistance has allowed us to get several of those features game-ready for this update, so thank you! These features include Leaderboards, both Local (Party Mode) and Global, along with the totally in-headset Choreography Tool. 

-------------------------------
[h3][i]Now all of the details you're looking for in this awesome update...[/i][/h3]

Features:
[list]

aaand...... that's all for now. 
[h2][i]Enjoy your trip![/i][/h2]
<3 Kinemotik

notes.title: Beta Update: Faster trips & fewer bugs!
notes.notes:
[h2]Beginner Difficulty Gemspeed Increase[/h2]
Per request, we recently rolled out much easier, slower Beginner levels. Well, now you've said they're a little [i]too[/i] slow. Well - how about we split the difference?! We've dialed this build in for a Beginner level that is still the same choreography as always, and slower than originally launched, but fast enough to be a bit challenging and full of energy. And now once you master Beginner, you should have an easier time jumping to Regular difficulties, and beyond!

[h2]Fixed Leaderboard Bug[/h2]
We also fixed an issue with scores not showing on the leaderboards. Don't Worry- Your scores are still there! Now you can see them again :) [b]Bug - squashed![/b] Thank you so much for testing the leaderboards so far in this beta channel. Thanks to you, we'll be rolling them out in the main channel soon. [i][b]We very much appreciate all of you helping us develop this game![/b][/i]

[h2]Performance Updates[/h2]
We also fixed some miscellaneous bugs that should help the game feel [b]buttery smooth[/b].



[h3]So, jump in, and as always, enjoy your trip. [/h3]
[h3]<3 Kinemotik[/h3]

notes.title: Beta Update: Leaderboards!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We are so excited to bring a huge update full of some of our more frequently requested new features and changes. Not only are there brand spakin’ new global leaderboards for you to test out, but we’ve also made some changes to Beginner & Expert level difficulties, along with making updates to all choreographies. As always we appreciate everyone who tests these builds and provides feedback, you rock!

-------------------------------

New in beta 1.0.1559b

These changes are in final testing, so give them and yourself a workout!

Features:[list]
[*]Global and Local (Party Mode) leaderboards for all Trip lengths and difficulties added. Challenge your friends in local (Party Mode) and claim your spot on our new Global Leaderboards to test them out!
[/list]
Gameplay:
[list]
[*]Beginner difficulty has been adjusted down. The approach rate of obstacles has been slowed down by 50%. We received feedback from players that Beginner difficulty was too challenging, and we hope this adjustment addresses that.

[*]Expert difficulty has been adjusted up. The approach rate of obstacles has been increased by 50%. We couldn’t make Beginner less challenging without making Expert MORE challenging. Enjoy!

[*]Choreography updated on all Trip difficulties and lengths to address player feedback regarding Trip flow and obstacle comfort with particular attention paid to movement efficiency. Our aim with these changes is to ensure players never feel their play-space isn’t large enough.

[*]Restart option when Paused has been added. 
[/list]
Misc:
[list]
[*]Overhaul of rendering subsystems to optimize performance

[*]Various graphical fixes and improvements
[/list] 

-------------------------------

To access the beta build:
[olist]
[*] Find Audio Trip in your Steam library and right-click on it.
[*] Click "Properties"
[*] Click the "BETAS" tab
[*] Under "Select the beta you would like to opt into:" drop the list down and select public_beta".
[*] You can now close the window and the beta version will begin installing!
[/olist]
-------------------------------
